scope: Small source delta and exactly 13 targeted synthetic tests; no large metadata assembly or full 69-test rerun

checks.strict_original_proof: runner4 supplies the unchanged protocol_v4 lock_proof callable and original owner/lock on every lease call. Observation matches exact RuntimeError text plus original lock_proof traceback filename/frame before unwinding.
checks.raw_failure_capture: Frozen capture helper retains raw, matches, owner, lock, actual process and info from the failing frame, with original traceback. Fresh reads cannot replace those original values.
checks.later_observations: fdinfo, global locks, namespace and separate-open contention/acquisition remain explicitly later observations. No returned diagnostic can satisfy admission or change the failed proof.
checks.original_exception: DiagnosticLease uses bare raise for the original exception, including after capture/persistence failure. Observation attempted once; later cleanup still calls the original proof. Outer handlers/finally and scientific orchestration AST are unchanged except declared diagnostic hooks.
checks.durable_pre_output_path: Exact research/<output-root-basename>-lock-failure.json is declared in spec before model output creation. Preflight rejects final or old staging entries and requires root floor plus 8 MiB reserve.
checks.actual_writer_binding: runner p comes through masks/five to protocol_v7; p.once is lifecycle_v4.once. That writer uses exclusive .pending-<stem>-<actual pid>.json, full fsync, rename_noreplace and directory fsync, matching DiagnosticLease/failurehelper paths.
checks.partial_evidence: failurehelper3 validates exact runner4 model argv/auditor3 argv, original model owner and physical drain, then retains exact diagnostic final or actual outer-PID staging digest/identity/status, including invalid JSON; rejects both present and never claims success.
checks.caller_source_closure: Builder3 closure includes diagnostic helper, frozen capture source and all successor external helpers; helper bindings point to runner4/auditor3. No source proof is replaced by diagnostics.
checks.budget_scope: Diagnostic is outside /mnt/nvme payload catalog, capped below 8 MiB with one final-or-stage file. Original scientific file/journal/slot and resource limits unchanged.

verification.test_runtime_operations: Only mocks, inert source imports/AST and synthetic fixture metadata; no real process/lock/model operations.

root_next_step: Use the actual latest serial catalog (parent reports v5, not historical v4 recorded in source delivery), a fresh run namespace and builder3. Review resulting concrete spec separately before actual runner4 admission.
failure_cause: Still unproven; two earlier bounded diagnostics did not reproduce the actual lease failure. This source change collects evidence and makes no transient/global-table/root-cause claim.
